title: everyone has one
subtitle: the voice that narrates your day

steps.text: let's start with something everyone has: an inner voice.
it's the voice that narrates your day. it reminds you of things. it comments on how it's going.

options.label: all day
options.reply: a busy one. that's really common.

options.label: sometimes
options.reply: makes sense. it comes and goes for most people.

options.label: not sure
options.reply: that's a good place to start. we'll listen for it together.

steps.text: people who study inner speech find it's a normal part of thinking. we use it to plan, to remember, and to get through hard moments.
it isn't always full sentences. sometimes it's just a word or two.

steps.prompt: which of these sound like your inner voice?
steps.reply: every one of those counts. that's your inner voice at work.

steps.text: here's the part we'll keep coming back to: your inner voice learned how to talk somewhere. it isn't the only way you can talk to yourself.
everyone has an inner voice. it's a habit of talking, and habits can grow.
once today, just notice your inner voice. no need to change anything.

grounding.idea: inner speech is a common part of everyday thinking, used for planning, memory and self-regulation
